subject: Cross-dock & demo-staging: consolidated crate plan and onsite routing
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: FreightCo Logistics <ops@freightco.com>, ExpoOps - Marina Park <sponsorship@exposure.com>, Tara Singh <tara.singh@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cross-dock & demo-staging: consolidated crate plan and onsite routing

Team / vendors —

We’re finalizing logistics for the AcmeCorp activation at Marina Park (Booth A9) and need confirmation on the cross-dock and demo-staging timeline. Key asks below: 

- Freight consolidation: We want FreightCo to receive 3 pallets + 2 crates at your Newark cross-dock between 7/8–7/10, consolidate into one truck, and deliver to the expo loading dock on 7/19 between 08:00–11:00. Please confirm truck length and lift-gate availability.

- Onsite staging window: ExpoOps confirmed a single delivery window (7/19 AM). We need a 90-minute staging slot at the dock for crate unwrapping and powering demo rigs. Any constraints around AV rigging or vehicle staging?

- Customs & paperwork: Crate labels include HT declarations but AcmeCorp asked we pre-fill the commercial invoice and NAFTA tariff codes (if applicable) to avoid delays. FreightCo — can you accept an emailed invoice + packing list and attach to the bill of lading?

- Overflow storage: If the booth build runs late we’ll need a short-term hold area (max 12 hours). ExpoOps — is there a secure vendor hold area we can reserve? Pricing?

Attachments: initial crate manifest and a high-level demo rig diagram.

Next steps: Please reply with the following by EOD 7/1 so we can lock vendors and update the onsite crew: 1) cross-dock acceptance window and lead time; 2) truck specs and any weight limits; 3) confirmation of 90-minute staging slot and whether power will be available at dock side.

Thanks — Sergio

--
Sergio Alvarez
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:54:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Cross-dock & demo-staging: consolidated crate plan and onsite routing

Hi Sergio / team —

Thanks for the heads up. FreightCo can receive the three pallets + two crates at our Newark cross-dock between 7/8–7/10. Notes: 

- Trucking: We will consolidate into a 26' box truck (single shipment). We can also provide a 48' tractor-trailer if you prefer fewer touches — let us know max dock length at Marina Park.
- Lift-gate: Available on request. Please flag in advance (we’ll bill the service to Redwood).
- Weight/axle limits: Max per crate 1,500 lbs. If any crate exceeds that we need a headcount to request special handling.
- Paperwork: We accept emailed commercial invoice + packing list. We’ll generate a BL and can append your documents. For cross-border material please add HS codes in the invoice; AcmeCorp’s broker can provide those if you don’t have them.

We’ve attached our standard cross-dock checklist and a short ETA matrix. If you want a 48' truck we need final confirmation by 7/5 to reserve equipment.

Regards,
Mike Chen
Operations Manager — FreightCo Logistics
ops@freightco.com | +1 973-555-4433

Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-dock & demo-staging: consolidated crate plan and onsite routing

All — quick clarifications from PM/logistics: 

1) Dock power: ExpoOps confirmed a single 20A outlet at the dock but it’s shared. We’ll need our own distro and 2 spare extension runs — I’ve asked AV to confirm cable lengths.
2) Crate breakdown: The two crates are the demo rigs (rig A = 1,250 lbs; rig B = 1,430 lbs). Pallets contain collateral and kit supplies (total ~820 lbs). So all under the 1,500 lb cap noted by FreightCo.
3) Staging priority: We need crate A staged closest to booth entrance (quick deploy) and crate B staged to the left for the tech team. Can FreightCo mark crates with 'RIG-A' / 'RIG-B' on the top?
4) Overflow hold: ExpoOps — we’ll take the hold area if available. Please share cost and security detail. If no hold area then FreightCo, do you offer a temporary hourly hold at your local yard for same-day delivery?

I’ll update the manifest and send to Tara for customs details — Tara, can you share your commercial invoice with HS codes by Friday 7/2?

Thanks,
Marissa

--

Subject: Re: Cross-dock & demo-staging: consolidated crate plan and onsite routing

Hi folks —

Thanks for the details. A few constraints from the venue side: 

- Single dock window: We can guarantee access 07:00–11:00 on 7/19. If the truck arrives earlier it will be held offsite until 07:00.
- Truck length: Maximum trailer length at the dock is 40'. 48' trailers are not permitted on the loading ramp — FreightCo, please confirm you can use 26' or 40'.
- Staging area: We have a secured vendor hold room (VHR-3) adjacent to Hall A. Fee is $150/hour; security on-site until 23:00 the day of delivery. Reserve required by 7/10.
- Forklift schedule: Venue forklift support is limited 07:00–10:30. If you need forklift after 10:30 you must bring a lift.

Power note: Dock-side power is 20A shared as Marissa called out. We can run an additional temporary feed for an hourly fee; needs onsite electrician approval and 72-hour lead.

Let us know whether you want to reserve VHR-3 and whether FreightCo can guarantee a max 40' trailer.

Best,
Rachel Park
Operations Lead — Marina Park Expo Center

- Venue (Marina Park) allows max 40' trailer and offers secured VHR-3 at $150/hr (reserve by 7/10). Forklift available until 10:30. Dock window on 7/19 is 07:00–11:00.

Action items & owners:

2) Tara (AcmeCorp) — send commercial invoice with HS codes to marissa.cole@redwood.com and ops@freightco.com by EOD 7/2.
3) Marissa — reserve VHR-3 if we want overflow hold and confirm distro lengths with AV (by 7/6).
4) Diego — I’ll produce a final consolidated manifest and pass to FreightCo for the BL once Tara confirms HS codes.

Please reply in-thread with approvals or questions. If anyone wants to hop on a quick 15-minute call tomorrow to align, I can schedule.
